title: Raw Pointers
summary: Raw pointers bypass borrow checker rules and require explicit unsafe blocks to dereference.
lecture: Raw pointers (*const T and *mut T) are primitive pointer types in Rust similar to C pointers.
Creating raw pointers from references or integers is completely safe in Rust code.
Dereferencing raw pointers to read or write memory is unsafe and requires explicit unsafe blocks.

example.caption: Creating raw pointers is safe, but reading them requires unsafe.
